jobs.employer_name: Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels NV

jobs.description:
Are you ready to take charge on a production line? Do you enjoy working with your hands and being part of a close team?

Join one of the world’s leading mushroom companies, right here in your region. As an operator, you’ll help keep the line running — adjusting machines, switching molds, and sealing mushroom boxes. You work 5 days a week, with either the full weekend off or a weekday off if you work Saturday. Your shift starts at 6am or 8am depending on the season.

What you can expect:

• A key role in a solid, reliable team
• Hands-on work with real responsibility
• A company that’s big in the global mushroom market
• Long-term opportunity for people who want to grow
Sound like your kind of job? Let’s talk!

• You’re someone who keeps an eye on the bigger picture — you think ahead, spot small issues before they become big ones, and help the line run like clockwork.
• Experience in a production environment is a plus, but if you’re motivated and hands-on, we’ll get you up to speed.
• The working language in the company is English, so Dutch is not required.

• Proven experience leading and developing teams.
• Analytical, structured, and detail-oriented.Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
• Interest in process optimization, automation, and digital finance solutions.

As a maintenance mechanic for trucks, you are responsible for the technical maintenance of trailers. You make sure that everything is ready for inspection and carry out interventions where needed. You replace brakes, shock absorbers and other worn parts. Welding work on trailers is also part of your job.

On a typical day, you start by checking trailers scheduled for inspection. You perform planned maintenance and repair defective parts. You assemble and disassemble components, work independently on repairs and coordinate with colleagues when necessary. If you have knowledge of hydraulics or electricity, that's a plus, but not a must. Communication with colleagues and, if needed, customers is in Dutch, French, English or German.

Do you like to get hands-on and make sure everything is in top technical condition? Are you solution-oriented and prefer to work independently? Apply now and take the first step toward this job!

• You have a diploma of lower secondary education or equivalent by experience

• You have at least 1 year of experience as a mechanic

• You can work independently and think in terms of solutions

• You have strong communication skills

• You have a good command of at least one of these languages: Dutch, French, English or German

• Basic knowledge of hydraulics or electricity is a plus, not a requirement

Join a company in Roeselare focusing on utility vehicles. You take care of preparing trailers for inspection, perform maintenance, and replace parts like brakes and shock absorbers. You also carry out welding tasks. Basic knowledge of hydraulics or electricity is a plus, not a must. You work independently, communicate in different languages, and handle a variety of tasks every day. Ready for a new step? Apply now!

• At least 1 year of experience as a mechanic

• Able to work independently

• Practical and problem-solving attitude

• Can communicate in Dutch, French, English, or German

• Welding skills preferred

• Basic hydraulics or electricity knowledge is an advantage

jobs.occupation: Sales Associate - Chocolate Boutique - Bruges City Centre
jobs.description:
Are you looking for an exciting opportunity in the heart of Bruges?

Do you want a job with real growth potential? Are you passionate about customer service and working with high-quality products?

Then this might be the perfect opportunity for you.

This renowned chocolate boutique, located in the historic centre of Bruges, specialises in premium Belgian chocolate and offers customers an authentic chocolate experience.

The shop is known for its wide selection of pralines, truffles, and other handcrafted chocolate delicacies, all made with passion and craftmanship.

We are currently looking for an enthusiastic and customer oriented Sales Associate to join their team.

Your daily responsibilities:

• Welcoming and assisting customers
• Replenishing stock and maintaining attractive product displays
• Handling payments and operating the cash register
• Providing information about the product range
• Performing accurate stock control and monitoring expire dates
• Maintaining a warm and welcoming attitude at all times

• Perfect English and basic Dutch, but willingness to learn
• Willingness to work weekends (1 day off during the weekend)
• Evening work: in July & August, closing time is 10 PM (maximum 11 closing shifts per month)
French, Spanish, Russian, Chinese are also languages we are looking for.

We are looking for loaders - unloaders for a leading logistics company specializing in the efficient transportation of goods.

This is an on-call position, where you will be deployed as needed, providing flexibility in your schedule.

This means we can also be flexible for you (for example, if there are certain days you cannot work, we can keep this in mind).

You'll work in a 2 shift system.

One week you'll work from 5h (morning) until 13h (afternoon)

The other week you'll work from 13h (afternoon) until 21h (evening)
- Vaardigheden:

You are flexible

You are able to do physical work 

You can work well in a team

You have your own transportation to get to work on these hours (bike, car, step,..)

- Talenkennis:

English

jobs.occupation: Become a Butcher in Wholesale – Quality Meat Processing in Aartselaar
jobs.description:
As a butcher in our wholesale department, you are responsible for expertly processing quality meat for professional customers in Belgium and abroad. You work precisely and efficiently in a modern production environment where craftsmanship is key. Your duties include deboning, cutting, and portioning beef, pork, lamb, and poultry to the specified weights and customer requirements. You also prepare ground meats and charcuterie, conduct quality checks, and ensure products are packaged and labeled correctly.

A typical workday starts early in the morning. You begin at 6:00 am with your close-knit team. Your responsibilities include deboning, cutting, and weighing meat, always paying attention to detail and quality. You follow strict procedures to guarantee food safety and contribute to a smooth production flow. During lunch, you and your colleagues enjoy our house-made meat products, and you finish your workday by 2:00 pm.

Are you a skilled professional who likes to roll up your sleeves and is committed to quality? Apply today and join our team of passionate butchers!

• Thorough knowledge of the complete breakdown and deboning of a beef carcass (very important)

• Skilled at cutting to weight and deboning meat

• Precise and efficient work ethic with a keen eye for detail and quality

• Motivated, reliable, and takes initiative

• Able to work independently and as part of a team

• Good command of English and willing to learn Dutch

• Willing to work occasionally on Saturdays if needed

• Completed lower or higher secondary education

• At least 2 years of experience as a butcher (5–10 years or more is a plus)

Our client, an international organisation active in technical services and customer support, is undergoing a major digital transformation across its European operations. To support this journey, they are looking for an experienced Business Analyst & Transformation Project Lead .

In this key position within the organization , you will drive business improvement initiatives, manage strategic projects, and act as the link between operational teams and IT.

Key Responsibilities

Project & Programme Management

• Manage a portfolio of business transformation and IT-related projects.
• Define priorities, timelines, budgets, and project deliverables.
• Coordinate stakeholders and ensure projects are delivered on time and within scope.
• Identify and mitigate risks throughout the project lifecycle.
Business Process Improvement

• Analyse existing business processes and identify opportunities for optimisation.
• Drive initiatives focused on standardisation, automation, and digitalisation.
• Support the development of scalable and efficient operational practices.
Requirements Analysis

• Gather, analyse, and document business requirements.
• Translate operational and commercial needs into clear functional specifications.
• Ensure requirements are understood by technical teams and external partners.
• Solution Development
Collaborate closely with IT and business systems teams.

• Evaluate and implement solutions that support both current and future business needs.
• Ensure technology investments deliver measurable business value.
Commercial & Supplier Management

• Support and lead commercial initiatives related to projects and business improvements.
• Manage relationships with external suppliers and service providers.
• Participate in contract discussions and monitor project budgets and performance.
 

Stakeholder Management

• Act as the primary contact between business operations and IT teams
• Build strong relationships across departments and facilitate effective communication.
• Ensure business priorities are clearly understood and aligned.

• Has proven experience managing business transformation projects and programmes.
• Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Is comfortable working with data and translating insights into actionable recommendations.
• Possesses strong commercial awareness and can assess the business impact of decisions.
• Has experience gathering and documenting business requirements.
• Can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Builds strong working relationships and influences stakeholders at different levels.
• Thrives in a dynamic environment and can manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Has experience working with IT, ERP, CRM, or other business systems teams.
• Is fluent in English; knowloedge of Dutch and/or French  is considered an asset.

HR Administrator Vacancy in Tervuren! Have you already built up HR knowledge through an initial work experience or a bachelor's degree? Then this international opportunity could be the perfect next step for you. Apply today for this exciting HR Administrator position in Tervuren!
 

 
 

 

As an HR Administrator, you will be in daily contact with employees and candidates, contributing to a positive employee and candidate experience. Thanks to your organizational skills, attention to detail, and proactive approach, you will provide valuable support to the HR team.
 

 
 

 

Your responsibilities:
 

 
• Provide general administrative support to the HR department and ensure accurate follow-up of HR processes.
 
• Maintain and update HR databases and employee records, ensuring all information remains accurate and up to date.
 
• Support the full recruitment process, including scheduling interviews, sending invitations, and handling administrative follow-up.
 
• Coordinate practical arrangements for candidates, such as travel bookings and hotel reservations, and welcome them professionally during their visit.
 
• Assist with training and development administration and respond to HR-related inquiries from employees and candidates. 

 

For this HR Administrator position, we are looking for an administrative professional who enjoys bringing structure and order. In addition, you gain energy from supporting and helping people.
 

Your profile:
 

 
• You possess HR knowledge gained through a first relevant work experience or a bachelor's degree in HR.
 
• You work accurately and in an organized manner and are able to manage multiple priorities efficiently.
 
• You have strong communication skills and adopt a professional, customer-oriented approach.
 
• You have an excellent command of Dutch and English.
 
• You are proficient in the MS Office Suite and quickly adapt to new systems and tools.

jobs.occupation: Senior Consultant - AI-Enabled IT Risk & Resilience Initiatives
jobs.description:
Our client, a leading organisation in the insurance sector, is driving an ambitious AI-enabled IT transformation and is looking for a Senior AI IT Risk, Compliance & Operational Resilience Consultant to join our client's team on a 12‑month contract in central Brussels. You will work closely with IT, Data, Architecture, Digital Technologies & AI teams to strengthen governance, risk management, regulatory compliance, operational resilience and fraud prevention around AI, cloud and ICT services, with a strong focus on regulations such as the AI Act, DORA, GDPR and CRA.
Languages

 
• English: Fluent

 
• Dutch: Basic

 
• French: Basic

 

To find out more about Huxley please visit www.huxley.com

 
• IT Risk & IT Governance (10+ years) - Assess and manage ICT and AI risks, define frameworks and controls across complex IT environments.

 
• Operational Risk & Compliance (10+ years) - Identify operational, cyber, regulatory, contractual and fraud risks and drive remediation plans.

 
• Audit, Internal Control or Risk Management - Prepare and support internal/external audits and regulatory inspections with structured evidence.

 
• Financial/Insurance Sector Experience - Apply industry-specific risk and compliance practices within a regulated environment.

 
• Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint - Produce professional risk registers, dashboards, impact assessments and executive reporting.

 
• AI & Generative AI Understanding - Evaluate risks linked to AI models, training data, LLMs and third‑party AI services.

 
• European AI Act Knowledge - Interpret and translate AI Act obligations into practical governance and compliance measures.

 
• Operational Resilience & Cybersecurity for AI - Strengthen resilience and security controls around AI-driven systems.

 
• Cloud, Outsourcing & ICT Risks - Advise on critical supplier management, exit strategies and outsourced service risk.

 
• DORA, GDPR & Third‑Party Frameworks - Align AI and ICT activities with EU regulatory requirements and supervisory expectations.

 
• Collaboration with IT, Architecture, Cybersecurity, Data & Digital Teams - Work cross‑functionally to embed risk, compliance and resilience in AI4IT programmes.

We are looking for a highly motivated Logistics Operator  for a leading company in the industrial sector. You will be responsible for ensuring smooth internal transport and efficient warehouse management.

 

Your mission;

You will play a crucial role in the efficient and safe processing of goods within the industrial site.

• You select and prepare the correct handling equipment, according to the characteristics of the products and the movement conditions.
• You welcome drivers to the industrial site, collecting and identifying documents from the administrative department.
• You are responsible for unloading or loading trucks.
• You move goods to the storage area and store the received raw materials in their appropriate locations.
• You check the condition of loads, identify anomalies, and pass them on to the relevant department.
• You carry out handling operations using handling equipment (such as forklifts, bulldozers, etc.).
• You ensure the order and cleanliness of the activity.
 

Your profile and skills;

• You are a true team player.
• You are eager to learn and always open to acquiring new skills.
• You are flexible and able to adapt easily to changing circumstances.
• You work in an organized manner and maintain oversight, even in a dynamic environment.
• Working safely comes naturally to you, and you strictly follow procedures.
• Experience with a forklift is a plus, although this is not a strict requirement.
• You have a good command of French and English , allowing you to communicate smoothly in the workplace.

We are looking for packing employees who are available to work in a three-shift system (food industry) in Dendermonde?

If you're interested, read the job description and apply!

You will be working in the packing department of a company that specializes in packaging frozen products. This role involves working in a refrigerated environment (approximately 10°C).

Your main tasks include:

• Checking product quality

• Packing various products (such as fish, snacks, vegetables, etc.) into boxes or bags

• Applying labels

• Stacking boxes on pallets

• Maintaining close communication with the operator

• Other related tasks

What we expect from you:

• You have previous experience in a production environment or are willing to learn, and you can work flexibly in a three-shift system (morning, late and night shift).

• You are comfortable performing physical work at a steady pace.

• You have a good command of Dutch or English to understand safety instructions.

• You can travel independently to Dendermonde each day, as the company is located in an industrial zone and is not accessible by public transport.

• You are looking for long-term employment and are willing to complete a 2-hour packing test after a successful interview.
